CustomField.description: Reason with an emoji for list views.
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(Reason__c), "Inaccurate", "⚠️ Inaccurate", "Incomplete", "🧩 Incomplete", "Not Relevant", "🎯 Not relevant", "Too Slow", "🐌 Too slow", "Unsafe Or Inappropriate", "🚫 Unsafe/inappropriate", "Other", "💬 Other", "–")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Why the response was not helpful.
CustomField.label: Reason Display
